coverageNote: Only recorded relations are shown; no record does not mean a resource is isolated

del.manualNote: This edge was entered by hand; deleting it is final — collection will not recreate it.
del.syncNote: ⚠️ This edge was inferred by collection and will come back on the next sync. To remove it for good, change the underlying configuration.
del.title: Delete relation

domains.hint: External domains derived from the host-record inventory. Wildcards (*), root records (@) and ACME validation hashes appear here too — these are real DNS records, not junk. Entries with a module come first; those are the ones with recorded ownership.
domains.title: Public domains ({{n}})
domains.truncated: {{n}} more not shown — narrow it down with the search box above

empty.filtered: No relations match the current filters.
empty.noSource: No resource relations recorded yet. That does not mean there are no dependencies — only that we have not recorded them.
empty.title: No relations recorded

form.desc: Most edges are inferred by collection. Add the ones it cannot infer — cross-system dependencies, external services.
form.noMatch: No match. A CI's name may differ from what the UI shows — try another keyword
form.pickHint: Search by name; the selection shows below
form.relTypeHint: Direction matters: A protects B is not the same as B protects A
form.title: Add a relation by hand

graph.empty: No relations found. That does not mean the object is isolated — the edge-building job may not have run.
graph.entryHint: Prefix with host: / lb: / domain: / cert: / svc: / ing: to filter by type
graph.noEntry: No match. Try another keyword, or prefix with host: / lb: / domain: / cert: / svc: / ing:
graph.noMembers: No member detail for this pool node
graph.pickFirst: Pick a starting object on the left. The graph shows what one object connects to; there is no global view.
graph.typeMore: Type at least 2 characters — an empty keyword would pull the whole table
